producer: Optional witness capture inside the existing independent bounded specialization correspondence checker; every witness is retained only after the complete relation succeeds.
validation: Exhaustive bijective target ownership is checked by psc-specialization-correspondence/1; names are taken from exact compared artifacts, never inferred from mangling.
Replay re-resolves caller-pinned exact subjects and reruns the relation, then compares the complete canonical map identity.
Witness bytes, instance count, composed type depth, instance key bytes and relation work remain bounded. The legacy report-only API does not collect witness metadata.
consumers: second typed output of actual specialization pass
compatibility: Historical one-output specialization passes keep their original records. New passes publish SpecializedIR and its exact map in ordered typed outputs; maps are not trusted as a replacement for relation replay.
remaining: Compose source declaration origins through exact erasure and specialization identities
